title: Say Nothing
author: Patrick Radden Keefe
summary: Patrick Radden Keefe uses the 1972 disappearance of Jean McConville, a mother of ten, to tell the story of the Troubles. He follows IRA members and what the violence left behind.
readIf: you want a gripping, well-researched look at the Troubles through real people.
skipIf: you want a neutral overview of Northern Irish history rather than a narrative of one case.
